title: Chained Tuning Leads to Biased Forgetting
findings: When a model fine-tuned for safety on the ToxiGenQA dataset is subsequently fine-tuned on a capability task, the 'Muslim' and 'Jewish' demographic groups are among those that suffer the most from 'biased forgetting' (a disproportionate loss of safety performance). Specifically, the 'Muslim' group was consistently the top group affected. For the BBQ dataset, the general 'Religion' category was among the least forgotten groups.
references: Anthropic. 2024. The Claude 3 Model Family: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku.

measurement_description: The paper measures 'biased forgetting', which is the disproportionate degradation in safety performance for specific demographic groups, including religious groups ('Muslim', 'Jewish', and the general 'Religion' category), after a model is sequentially fine-tuned on a capability task.
